annotations.title: pdfpeek: build an Excel workbook from JSON

description: pdfpeek: Build a styled Excel workbook from JSON sheets, columns and rows. To read a workbook back use convert_excel_to_json; for slides use build_pptx_deck. Rows are arrays or objects; a column `type` (string, number, integer, date, datetime, boolean, currency, percent) sets the format. Strings are always stored as text, never as formulas. At most 20 sheets, 50,000 cells, 32,767 characters per cell; sheet names of at most 31 characters without [ ] : * ? / \. Over a limit is a 422 (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.005. No free tier. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/xlsx-build-api.html

format.description: Custom Excel number format (for example "€#,##0.00") instead of the type's default.
format.title: Format

header.description: Header text (also the key that picks the value when rows are objects).
header.title: Header

type.description: string, number, integer, date, datetime, boolean, currency or percent. Sets the cell type and number format; a value that does not fit is a 422. Without it the type follows each JSON value.
type.title: Type

width.description: Column width in characters; default: fitted to the content.
width.title: Width

autofilter.description: Filter buttons on the header row.
autofilter.title: Autofilter

columns.description: Typed columns. Omit them and object rows give the headers from their keys (first-seen order); array rows then have no header row.
columns.title: Columns

rows.description: Array rows (values by position) or object rows (values by header). A value is a string, number, boolean or null (an empty cell).
rows.title: Rows

filename.description: Name of the returned file (default workbook.xlsx; .xlsx is added when missing; only letters, digits, space, dot, dash and underscore are kept).
filename.title: Filename

output.description: base64 (default): inline. url: stored for 24 hours; link, metadata.
output.title: Output

sheets.description: The sheets, in order: 1-20, each with a unique name, optional typed columns and rows (at most 50,000 cells in all).
sheets.title: Sheets

name: build_xlsx_workbook

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
